observations.what: Tall pointed wizard hat in deep midnight navy with a bent tip and hand-drawn star decoration
Smooth frankfurter sausage head with two black bead eyes and a sidewise '3' pursed mouth
Oversized flared white standing collar framing the neck of the hot dog wizard
Long billowing midnight-blue cloak decorated with yellow five-point star line drawings
Right arm outstretched to the left with an open palm holding an upright stance
Small hovering azure cyan flame levitating weightlessly above the open palm
Slender crooked wooden wizard staff gripped in the left hand running down toward the ground
Pair of spindly frankfurter legs supporting the rounded torso with curved sausage feet
Hand-inked comic header lettering reading 'you're A Glizard 'ARRY' across the upper canvas
Vast empty negative space encircling the character and pushing all weight into the center column

creatures.name: glizard-the-hotdog-mage
creatures.source: Central anthropomorphic hot dog frankfurter wizard with cloak, hat, and spindly noodle legs.

shape.summary: Chunky toy frankfurter wizard standing proudly on thin terracotta sausage legs clad in a star-speckled midnight robe.

creatures.pose: Stands erect on spindly frankfurter legs atop the collar dais, right palm raised flat toward the west and left hand resting on an imaginary staff.
creatures.why: Faithfully reproduces the iconic illustration subject holding court on the central peak.

legend.R: raised ground (plateau, one or more blocks above G)

focal.what: The Glizard seated in high-standing-collar state atop the tier-3 peak.

composition.mass: Visual mass sits in a heavy central vertical pillar leaning slightly right of center between columns 7 and 10, echoing the hot dog wizard's dominant figure column.
composition.read: The viewer's eye enters from the narrow southern tongue at row 10 and travels straight up the stone path ridge. It crests at row 5 where the towering frankfurter mage stands against the night sky, with balance provided by the western flame outcrop and the eastern wooden spire.

lighting.notes: paper-canvas high-key radiance: ANALYSIS.palette.value_structure notes an extreme high-key composition where light values dominate 80%+ of the frame, requiring high ambient illumination paired with a deep void backdrop.

rules: Keep all water share at zero to match the completely dry paper void of the artwork.
Concentrate the tallest elevation exclusively in the central column from row 3 to 6.
Flank the central summit with distinct western flame and eastern staff wings.
Maintain a wide perimeter of empty void to preserve the 80% negative space composition.

lens.aspect: composition.mass and composition.flow_lines directly translated into topographic massing and ridge elevation
lens.place: An isolated spire-cairn monolith jutting above an abyss, transcribing the solitary vertical silhouette of the cloaked charcuterie conjurer.
lens.summary: Transforms the vertical massing of the hot dog mage and its asymmetric balancing arms into a stepped mountain crag rising sharply from empty space.
lens.differs: Unlike the ink ribbonway or subterranean mustard vat cellar, this level builds a soaring vertical pyramid monolith that mirrors the drawing's mass box and flow lines in actual physical elevation.
fixes: surface_mix led with grass after a sibling took sand/dirt

concept.name: lens-composition
concept.fragment: LENS "composition": the drawing's STRUCTURE becomes the terrain literally. Start from ANALYSIS.composition. The main mass becomes the highest land, placed where it sits in the frame; the flow lines become the path and the ridges, running the same way; the negative space becomes void (bays and gaps cut into the island) or open ground; symmetry or its absence decides "symmetric" versus an asymmetric shaper; scale cues decide how big the figure stands against the land. Choose the shaper and its params as a transcription: peak, center, from, ratio, split, turns and hand must be read off the frame positions in the analysis (x left to right 0..1, z top to bottom 0..1). Map picture to plan this way: the top of the frame is the far rim (row 0), the bottom is the near rim (row 11). Lighting follows ANALYSIS.palette.value_structure: where the lights and darks fall becomes where sun and shadow fall, and a high-key or low-key picture sets ambient. The figure stands at the focal point and its pose repeats the drawing's main gesture line. Palette follows the value map: the surfaces are ranked by value as the picture's areas are (the emptiest area becomes the palest surface, the densest the darkest), with the piece's accent hue kept for the focal point and its threshold. Props mark the structure: posts along a flow line, a gap where the negative space opens, a counterweight at the second mass.
